Noah Patel: quick preflight for cloud store publish — checklist: logos, SKU table, legal appendix, AMI/GCP image, manifest validation. aiming to submit tomorrow morning.
Rina Kapoor: i'll own image builds and tagging. will push AWS AMI + GCP image to staging and post IDs.
Samira (Legal): EULA appendix ready but need confirmation on telemetry wording for Azure (they insist on explicit opt-out). uploading now.
Noah Patel: thanks. SKU question: should IDs include cloud suffix or be neutral? finance prefers neutral core SKU + cloud mapping.
Rina Kapoor: i'll supply map: RDW-INF-PRO -> RDW-INF-PRO-AWS / -GCP / -AZ during manifest generation.
infra-bot: Reminder: run `./tools/marketplace/validate_manifest.sh` and `./tools/marketplace/check_assets.py` before submit. CI will block if images mismatch.
Rina Kapoor: AMI id (staging): ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, GCP image: redwood-inference-staging-2026-03-22. tagged `marketplace-staging`.
Samira (Legal): appended Azure checkbox copy: "I agree to distributor terms and telemetry as described." please attach support contact and SLA blurb.
Noah Patel: use partners-support@redwood.ai and link to SLA doc. i'll draft a 5-step publish runbook and share. target submit window: 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Rina Kapoor: will run validation after Samira confirms appendix. if CI passes i'll queue the publish.
Noah Patel: great — ACTIONS: Rina = images + manifest, Samira = final appendix, Noah = runbook + submit. ping here on completion. :white_check_mark:
